name: stac-ladder
decision: Jerry 2026-11-08: 'how can we screen our best policies vs STAC now trading is fixed'; evaluation principle (same day): screens vs our best policies and the best external policies.
host: ultra, both configs launched together (3 blocks each at a time); run only after Codex PASS on this predeclaration
trading: player_trading chat (PR #47): offers and answers both ways; our policy's offer and accept logic; plain JSettlers excluded (ignores chat)
health_bar: per receipt: all 768 games completed, 0 bridge errors, 0 offer timeouts, every game logged hidden with chat on, every logged seed equal to the derived one, STAC results agree on every winner; scripts/stac_paired.py healthy (<= 5% of pairs excluded). A receipt failing health is reported but its shares are not used.

reported.per policy and opponent: win share, Wilson 95%, fair share .25, retirement rule (share >= .50 with Wilson lower bound > .40)
reported.paired: tiles - served per opponent: mean paired difference with a two-sided paired-normal 95% interval (a measurement, not a gate)
reported.also: mean VP, position counts, chat-trade counts (offers sent/accepted/rejected, answers), executed player trades, MCTS cap hits/overruns, decision latency

precision.note: Sized for a benchmark table (shares to about +/-.05), not for detecting a small difference between the two policies; a paired difference under ~.07 is not expected to be resolved.

analysis_command: python scripts/stac_paired.py runs/stac-ladder-v1/tiles/receipt.json runs/stac-ladder-v1/served/receipt.json --expect pomcp_ts_cr=256 --expect stac_negotiator=512 --out runs/stac-ladder-v1/paired.json
note: Predeclared 2026-11-08 before any ladder game; fresh STAC seed 20261115.
amendment_2026_11_08: Codex HOLD @42aad77 (before any ladder game): stac_paired.py now takes the declared coverage as input and requires typed health evidence, unique complete game records per opponent and zero truncation; only setup-evidence differences count toward the 5% exclusion allowance. Runs, sizes and seeds unchanged.
